description: This Java class 'JwtService' provides methods for generating, parsing, and validating JWT tokens using the HS256 algorithm. It handles key initialization with a secret, token creation with subject and claims, and token validation.

classes.name: JwtService
classes.description: A service class responsible for generating, parsing, and validating JWT tokens in a Spring application.

methods.name: JwtService
methods.description: Constructor initializing the signing key based on the secret and setting token expiration duration.

methods.name: generateToken
methods.description: Creates a JWT token with a subject and optional claims, setting issued at and expiration times.

methods.name: parseToken
methods.description: Parses and validates a JWT token, returning claims if valid.

methods.name: validateAndGetSubject
methods.description: Validates a token and extracts the subject (e.g., email) if the token is valid.
